summary: Milestone 2026.09.667 completed 9 experiments, all compute-bound, totaling 25.6 wall-time minutes. The longest experiment was 'Test goal-safe planning on adapter-withheld live attempts' at 13.58 minutes, followed by 'Measure goal-safe search through the scored ARC wrapper' at 6.05 minutes and 'Compare bounded Qwen evidence against structural witnesses' at 1.95 minutes. Intra-experiment sub-phase profiling was not recorded, so granular internal execution costs could not be isolated.
bottlenecks_identified: The slowest experiment 'Test goal-safe planning on adapter-withheld live attempts' consumed 13.58 minutes (53.0% of the 25.6 total milestone wall-time minutes), but the lack of sub-phase profiling prevents isolating how much time was spent in model evaluation versus planning search or verification.

The top two compute-bound experiments ('Test goal-safe planning on adapter-withheld live attempts' at 13.58 minutes and 'Measure goal-safe search through the scored ARC wrapper' at 6.05 minutes) together accounted for 19.63 of the 25.6 total wall-time minutes (76.7%) without stage-level execution traces.
The 5 slowest experiments collectively accounted for 23.85 of the 25.6 total wall-time minutes (93.2%), with task durations reconstructed from disk mtime rather than live interval event logs.

The GPU monitor report provides an isolated post-execution snapshot (both RTX 3090 GPUs at 4MB allocated, 0% utilization) and does not capture active-window accelerator utilization while gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is false.
No experiment records indicate concurrent multi-model execution, making DualGPURunner dispatch inapplicable for the tasks completed this milestone.
improvements_suggested: Introduce monotonic sub-phase timers inside compute-bound experiments—especially live planning and scored wrapper paths—to separate model inference time from planner search and verification checks.
Capture continuous in-run GPU telemetry during compute-bound executions to evaluate accelerator utilization and VRAM dynamics across active task windows.
Record model inventory and concurrency metadata in experiment execution manifests to verify DualGPURunner eligibility when multiple models are executed.
Persist structured milestone run logs with exact start and end timestamps to avoid falling back to disk-mtime timing reconstruction.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument sub-phase duration counters in the ARC live planning and scored wrapper execution paths to decompose compute overhead.
Implement continuous GPU utilization logging during compute-bound task runs to record active-window accelerator metrics.
Log model concurrency and runner dispatch decisions in experiment receipts to audit DualGPURunner usage on multi-model workloads.
meta_reflection: Across 25.6 wall-time minutes, milestone 2026.09.667 completed 9 compute-bound experiments dominated by live goal-safe planning (13.58 minutes) and scored wrapper measurement (6.05 minutes). While the point-in-time GPU monitor snapshot showed both GPUs idle with 4MB allocated, gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is false and in-run accelerator metrics were unmeasured, with no multi-model tasks present to engage DualGPURunner. Implementing sub-phase profiling and continuous accelerator telemetry represents the highest-leverage path to isolating operational bottlenecks in subsequent milestones.
